data: Does the red line in the left graph in the middle row consistently have higher values than the dashed green line in the same graph?

The red line represents cSMTiser+LM, and the dashed green line represents NMT-1. The question asks whether the red line consistently has higher values than the dashed green line across all training data sizes. 

From the analysis of the graphs, we can see that the red line (cSMTiser+LM) generally lies above the dashed green line (NMT-1) across most of the training data range. However, there are some instances where the dashed green line (NMT-1) surpasses the red line (cSMTiser+LM). For example, in the German (RIDGE) graph, the dashed green line (NMT-1) is above the red line (cSMTiser+LM) at lower training data sizes. Therefore, the red line does not consistently have higher values than the dashed green line.
